name: katip-kalkan
description: Mask Turkish personal data on your computer before Claude reads a document.
long_description: Katip opens client documents (.docx, UYAP .udf, .txt, text-layer .pdf) on your computer, removes names, T.C. kimlik numbers, addresses, phones, IBANs and KVKK Article 6 data locally, and gives Claude only the masked text. The placeholder map stays encrypted on your computer; restore_to_file writes the final document with real names locally, without showing them to Claude. No network access.

tools.name: mask_file
tools.description: Open a document on this computer and return only masked text

tools.name: write_masked_copy
tools.description: Save a masked copy next to the original

tools.name: restore_to_file
tools.description: Write the final text with real values to a local file

tools.name: forget_matter
tools.description: Delete the local placeholder map of a matter

tools.description: Show engine, threshold and vault location

allowed_dir.description: Katip only opens files inside this folder.

address_detail.title: Address masking
address_detail.description: street = keep mahalle, street and district readable, mask building and door (default); full = mask the whole address.
